label: The efficient and total cause of a thing's being r contains r, formally or eminently
paraphrase: Analyst formulation of the Cartesian containment clause (navigation: Descartes, Meditation III, 'efficient and total cause'; attribution deferred): whatever is the efficient and total cause of x's being r (a CAUSE_2 cause whose causing needs no co-cause), where x is in act in r, is itself in act in r, formally or eminently (the open mode of IN_ACT_4). Partial causes are not constrained. Open.
